MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.

4. When learning Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.

7. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Photography.

8. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.

9. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.

10. When learning Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

11. When learning Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.

12. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre - Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre - Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre - Production.

13. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

14. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.

15. When learning Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

16. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Video Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Audio Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
